items.difficulty_reason: Base change of pushforward along a 2-cartesian square of stacks: for y' over V the author exhibits the equality of slice 2-fibre products (Sch/V)_fppf x_{g(y'),Y} X = (Sch/V)_fppf x_{y',Y'} (Y' x_Y X) and deduces the bijection g^{-1}f_*F(y') -> f'_*(g')^{-1}F(y') from the pushforward formula, omitting by name only the compatibility with restriction mappings. Retained author proof at lines 782-795.
